title: Only Tokens
tagline: Cross chain swap integration for 1inch Fusion+ with Cosmos and Dogecoin
description: This project enables seamless cross-chain swaps between Cosmos and Dogecoin using 1inch Fusion+, integrated with a user-friendly frontend application for efficient order creation, deposits, withdrawals, and refunds. It leverages advanced blockchain interoperability to ensure secure and fast transactions across these ecosystems.
how_its_made: Utilizing Cosmos' Cosmwasm smart contracts and Dogecoin's escrow mechanism, the project facilitates trustless HTLC (Hashed Timelock Contract) swaps via 1inch Fusion+, allowing users to securely deposit funds, execute cross-chain transactions, and withdraw or refund with ease. The frontend provides a streamlined interface, enhancing user experience and accessibility for managing cross-chain operations.
